attempts.summary: Built the node2/node3-via-node1 routed topology (previously unconfigured) and applied a VyOS QoS rate-control policy on node1's eth2 (facing node3) egress, capping node2→node3 traffic at 1Mbit/s while leaving node3→node2 unrestricted. Verified with iperf3 baseline (~24Gbit/s unshaped) and post-shaping (~0.97Mbit/s node2→node3 vs ~0.5-1.5Gbit/s node3→node2). All three nodes (node1, node2, node3) were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol; each showed a changed boot_id and fully recovered network config, IP forwarding, VyOS QoS policy, and shaping behavior (re-verified end-to-end with iperf3 after all three restarts).
